mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained HOUST increase, or HOUST growth does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with subsequent supply-side weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY is above 2.5%, the combination signals a tightening monetary environment with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.
